name: amg-webui
description: 对标并超越 Element Plus —— 最强国产 Vue3 WebUI（amg-webui）。0.1 试用版：承诺精选子集，API 可变。

scripts.test:ssr: vitest run tests/unit/ssr-env.spec.ts tests/unit/ssr-import.spec.ts tests/unit/ssr-hydration.spec.ts tests/unit/theme-core.spec.ts
scripts.test:a11y-browser: npm run build:example && playwright test tests/e2e/a11y-core-contrast.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:lowcode-golden-path: npm run build:example && playwright test tests/e2e/lowcode-golden-path.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.hardening:evidence: npx vitest run tests/unit/hardening/family-evidence.spec.ts && npx playwright test tests/e2e/hardening-family-evidence.spec.ts --project=chromium && node scripts/hardening/summarize-family-evidence.mjs && node scripts/hardening/merge-family-evidence.mjs
scripts.hardening:templates-verify: node scripts/hardening/verify-component.mjs Button && node scripts/hardening/verify-component.mjs Select && node scripts/hardening/verify-component.mjs DatePicker && node scripts/hardening/verify-component.mjs Dialog && node scripts/hardening/verify-component.mjs DataTable
scripts.hardening:all: npm run hardening:generate && npm run hardening:templates && npm run hardening:batches && npm run audit:api && node scripts/hardening/verify-component.mjs --all --strict && npm run check:evidence-freshness && npm run hardening:demote && npm run hardening:ssr && npm run hardening:visual && npm run hardening:dashboard && npm run generate:docs-sidebar && npm run hardening:release && npm run check:version-consistency
scripts.ci: vue-tsc --noEmit && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:version-consistency && npm run validate:catalog && npm run extract:i18n && npm run test && npm run test:ssr && npm run build:lib && npm run check:dist && npm run test:consumers
scripts.showcases:build: npm run showcase:admin:build && npm run showcase:saas:build && npm run showcase:ecommerce:build && npm run showcase:content-management:build && npm run showcase:device-management:build && npm run showcase:video-surveillance:build && npm run showcase:gb28181-center:build && npm run showcase:onvif-center:build && npm run showcase:dashboard:build && npm run showcase:mobile-admin:build
